title: Learn4Good Jobs Scraper
description: Scrape jobs from Learn4Good.com listings. Provide a keyword to search for jobs.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job search keyword(s), e.g., 'Software Developer'. This is required.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional: Geographic location to search in, e.g., 'London'.

posted_date.title: Posted Date
posted_date.description: Filter jobs by how recently they were posted.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of jobs
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of jobs to collect. Leave empty to collect all available jobs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for the best results.
